import subprocess,json,pathlib
cmd="etos query --json \"SELECT * FROM gc_dialogue_node WHERE owner='30aaae0a97dbbea82ee3fb01e2d9ed34865e7efc33bc54d3a1c5eb1ae96a2368' AND graph='30aaae0a97dbbea82ee3fb01e2d9ed34865e7efc33bc54d3a1c5eb1ae96a2368:76f3902df5c1ad4728518ff290ebd9cd' AND removed=false\""
p=subprocess.run(cmd,shell=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
receipt={'command':cmd,'exitCode':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr,'graphId':'30aaae0a97dbbea82ee3fb01e2d9ed34865e7efc33bc54d3a1c5eb1ae96a2368:76f3902df5c1ad4728518ff290ebd9cd'}

print('exit:',p.returncode,'stdout bytes:',len(p.stdout.encode()),'stderr bytes:',len(p.stderr.encode()))
print('rows:',len(json.loads(p.stdout).get('rows',[])) if p.returncode==0 else 'failure')
PY
